title: The closing age gag with the bandleader
summary: He explains the bow gag in which the band leader asks their ages and delivers a Yiddish punchline.

blocks.x: The bit we do about age. Buck is 18, I'm 19, one one-year difference. He would say, "How old are you?" to

my partner, Buck will say, "I'm 18," and he'd say to me, "How old are you?" I'd say, "I'm twice as dirty." And he'd say, "The little is 18 and the big one is 19 and the difference is a [swallow] sure and a black ear," you know. That's what the band leader is supposed to say. Which was typical, okay?
